apis.name: Nager.Date
apis.why_notable: Free public holiday API covering 100+ countries; widely used no-key staple for holiday calendars.

apis.name: AbstractAPI Holidays
apis.why_notable: Paid holiday API with free tier; country-level public holidays and observance metadata.

apis.name: Calendarific
apis.why_notable: Comprehensive holiday API for 200+ countries including religious and optional observances.

apis.name: HolidayAPI
apis.why_notable: Long-running public holiday API with free and paid plans; multi-country coverage.

apis.name: Ticketmaster Discovery API
apis.why_notable: Industry-standard live events discovery: concerts, sports, arts across Ticketmaster inventory.

apis.name: SeatGeek Platform API
apis.why_notable: Ticket marketplace API for events, venues, performers, and listings with free developer access.

apis.name: Eventbrite API
apis.why_notable: Major self-serve event creation and discovery platform API for listings and ticketed events.

apis.name: Meetup API
apis.why_notable: Community events and groups API for local meetups, RSVPs, and event discovery.

apis.name: PredictHQ
apis.why_notable: Enterprise-grade events intelligence API for demand forecasting: concerts, sports, holidays, severe weather.

apis.name: Google Calendar API
apis.why_notable: Canonical calendar CRUD and free/busy API; free under Google Cloud free tier quotas.

apis.name: Microsoft Graph Calendar
apis.why_notable: Outlook/Exchange calendar API via Microsoft Graph with free developer tenant access.

apis.name: SerpApi Google Events
apis.why_notable: Scrapes Google Events SERP results into structured JSON for local event discovery.

apis.name: Luma API
apis.why_notable: Modern event platform API popular with tech communities for calendar and guest management.

apis.name: Bandsintown Concerts API
apis.why_notable: Artist concert tour dates and event listings widely used by music apps.

apis.name: OpenHolidays API
apis.why_notable: Open-data European public and school holidays API with free unrestricted access.

apis.name: Checkiday API
apis.why_notable: National and fun "day of" holidays API (e.g., National Pizza Day) beyond statutory holidays.

apis.name: Dice FM API
apis.why_notable: Music events and ticketing platform API for club/festival listings (partner/self-serve developer access).

apis.name: Fever API
apis.why_notable: Experience and local event marketplace API for curated activities and tickets.

apis.name: TicketWeb API
apis.why_notable: Live entertainment ticketing API for venues and promoters (US-focused inventory).

apis.name: Universe API
apis.why_notable: Ticketmaster-owned event creation/ticketing API for independent organizers.
